loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (silent) to 4 (debug). Higher values produce more logs.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file. Must be writable by the iscsiuio user.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to match CPU cores for best performance.

mgmt_port.description: TCP port for the management interface. Set to 0 to disable.

mgmt_host.description: IP address to bind the management interface. Use `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces.

default_discovery_addr.description: Default IP address or hostname used for sendtargets discovery when no target IP is provided.

default_autologin.description: If true, automatically log in to discovered targets. Otherwise, require manual login.

default_login_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for login operations before timing out.

default_max_reconnect.description: Maximum number of reconnection attempts per session before giving up.

default_reconnect_interval.description: Seconds to wait between reconnection attempts.

delay_start.description: If true, delay startup to wait for network interfaces to come up.

delay_start_seconds.description: Duration (seconds) to wait if `delay_start` is enabled.

session_defaults.description: Optional list of per-session configuration presets for dynamically discovered targets. Each entry defines default timeouts and buffer sizes.

description.description: Optional human-readable label for this session preset.

replacement_timeout.description: Seconds before the session replacement timeout triggers.

abort_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting stuck I/O operations.

reset_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before resetting the connection on errors.

max_recv_data_segment_length.description: Maximum size (bytes) of received data segments (MaxRecvDataSegmentLength).
